lines.trans: Here is dessert from our pastry chef.
Thank you for changing the menu for me.
I am the chef and I fulfill any orders.
And what do you do, if it is not a secret?
I work as a judge at the Tverskoy court.
Whoa! And they suspended my license yesterday!
What is your last name?
My last name is Barinov. Viktor Barinov.
So it was I who issued that decision!
Maybe we can fix everything?
No. You knocked down a traffic light on the road!
But I had a valid excuse.
Say thank you that the suspension is only a year.
